notes.title: Content Update: New CORE and Gauntlet Levels!
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

A new content update is hear. Here's what it contains:
- 3 new CORE levels to test your combat skills
- 2 new Gauntlet levels to test your reflexes and finesse
- Updates to the Credits menu
- Minor bugfixes and optimizations

Don't die!
- Devon

notes.title: Day One Optimization Hotfix + Demo Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey Pilots! Just pushed out a few little quick performance updates to the game:

- Updated the whole Centauri Dark Demo to be more analogous to the current state of the main game
- Render distance optimizations
- light culling to reduce drawcalls caused by enemy lights on the environment
- dynamic batching optimizations to reduce GPU material render load

Happy fighting!
-Devon
